title: The Locker of Lake Minnow
author: E. M. Fairweather
blurb: Hazel Dravenmoor, the only out kid in a town of nine hundred, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. But when a best friend goes missing, leaving only a set of keys behind, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does before the final audition.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
